item.title: Putting an LLM on a Leash: Gates, Budgets and Prompt Injection in a Kubernetes Operator
item.description: Adding a model to a Kubernetes operator is the easy part. The work is the interface, the gate, the budget ceiling, and making sure untrusted scanner output cannot talk to the model as if it were you.
